cartographic_sources.survey: IGN BD TOPO V3 piste_d_aerodrome / batiment, queried 2026-10-06; complete 1266-building pagination
cartographic_sources.notes: Surveyed pavement and building footprints. Eastern glider access/apron traced from orthophoto, TWY L identified in VAC. Runway 2100 x 45 m with DTHR offsets 255/125 m. Grass runways 1190 x 50 m and 400 x 60 m anchored to published coordinates. Runway paint schematic. Old stand labels 1-5 lie mainly west of the airside apron and are not identified on SIA charts; use parking names instead. No yellow guidance lines or illuminated stop bars.
